user.title: Set up Climate Entity Builder
user.description: Creates a Climate Entity Builder hub. You can set up more than one, e.g. one per floor - each hub has its own independent set of custom preset profiles, offered only to the thermostats added under that hub. Afterwards, use "Add thermostat" and "Add profile" on the hub's device page.

user.title: Add profile
user.description: Define a custom preset: a name and a temperature. It's offered as an extra preset (alongside comfort/eco) on every thermostat under this hub, but only while a thermostat is in heat mode.

data_description.name: Shown as the preset's name on every thermostat under this hub, e.g. "Boost" or "Vacation". Can't be one of the built-in preset names (none/comfort/eco/window_open).
data_description.temperature: Applied as the target temperature the moment this preset is selected on a thermostat.
data_description.icon: Shown on a thermostat itself while this profile is its active preset - not in the preset picker's own list, which can't show a custom icon for a dynamically-named preset.
